Correction:
The validated certificate token no longer recalculates its immutable SHA-256 identity during rendering.
Asset admission still recomputes and validates the complete certificate.
Runtime tracing still validates the supplied stylus geometry.

The middle reversal mean decreases by approximately 34.1 percent.
